newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-KRAJICEK OUT FOR 10 WEEKS AFTER KNEE SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KRAJICEK OUT FOR 10 WEEKS AFTER KNEE SURGERY.

text.p: Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek will be out of the game for up to 10 weeks after undergoing knee surgery on Monday, Dutch ANP news agency said.
Krajicek, who has suffered from knee trouble for some time, had a piece of cartilage removed from his right knee during an operation at a Rotterdam hospital.
The Dutchman will miss the Australian Open in Melbourne in January.
